description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and max activation value for different components of a model. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 21, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 50.  A dashed blue line, labeled “attn_output”, begins at approximately 10 at layer 0 and fluctuates around 20-30 until layer 18, then rises sharply to approximately 170 at layer 21. A dotted orange line, labeled “attn_residual”, starts at 0 at layer 0 and remains close to 0 until layer 18, where it begins to increase, reaching approximately 80 at layer 21. A dashed green line, labeled “ffn_output”, begins at approximately 10 at layer 0 and remains relatively constant around 10-20 until layer 18, then increases to approximately 150 at layer 21. A solid red line, labeled “ffn_residual”, starts at 0 at layer 0 and gradually increases to approximately 380 at layer 21.
